description: desired.v2 §2.10, §3: the packed Report of desired.v2.json. Computed twice by two scripts of the text's drafter that share no code, kept out of the repository, and never blessed. `layout` is the Report's layout form, the sha256 of its JCS bytes, its tag, and its shortest and longest record in bits, before the pad. `writes`: a report in the profile's reading -> the record's `fields` (core §7.6's JSON reading: an absent optional field no member, an enum's escape null, a reserved code its name), its `bits` before the pad, the `pad` and the bytes in `hex`; with `stamp`, the target's own version of that put, also the put's `payload`: CH (form 0, the stamp's width bit, the Report's tag), the run, the seq, the record; or {refused: token}, the writer's, as core's packed/vectors.json names them (`range`, a value with no code; `value`, a name not declared). The profile's reading is {source, outcome, last_known, observed?, in_force?, refusal?}: observed and in_force are {version, revision?}, a version written <run>/<seq> (§2.4: the run in 4 lowercase hexadecimal digits for a 16-bit run and 8 for a 32-bit run, the seq in decimal); in_force absent is the field `none`, equal to observed in its version is `observed`, and any other is `other` with the four in_force fields; refusal is {code, pointer?, detail?}, code null for a code of the type's own, pointer and detail an index or "out_of_range". `reads`: CH's `tag` and the record's bytes -> {refused: token}, core §7.6's reading (tag, length, code, extension, pad; a marker read as 1 ends the reading, the rest a later text's, which must hold at least one bit), an unreadable report; or {fields, findings, report?}: the record's fields, §2.10's consistency findings in the order checked (escape, alone; run_fields; observed_outcome; refusal; source; in_force; revision_on_revert; last_known), and, with no finding, the profile's reading. A version is stated by its seq and exactly one of its two runs; a check that reads a version reads a stated one. `places`: a report resource's two tables and a refusal's place (a JSON Pointer, or null for none) and line (or null) -> the indices a target writes: a listed place its index; an unlisted one its nearest listed ancestor, the longest listed pointer other than "" that the place continues with a /, else out_of_range; a listed line its index, an unlisted one out_of_range; no member for none. `words`: the tables a reader holds (null: it holds no revision of the target's contract) and a refusal's indices -> the word of each: the entry, null for an index past the table (shown as its number), or "out_of_range".
